You are a programming expert.
        You will be given the root cause of a bug and some code statements that lead to the bug.
        Rank these code statements based on their relevance to the root cause of the bug.
        
        Root cause:
        The bug was caused by the `mcrf` emulation code using the Condition Register (CR) field numbers directly as shift values without accounting for the fact that CR fields are numbered from 0 to 7 starting at the high bits. This resulted in the CR fields being accessed in reverse order, leading to incorrect behavior during emulation.
        
        code statements:
        -			rd = (instr >> 21) & 0x1c;
-			ra = (instr >> 16) & 0x1c;
+			rd = 7 - ((instr >> 23) & 0x7);
+			ra = 7 - ((instr >> 18) & 0x7);
  

        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Ranked Code statements:
        <text1>
        <text2>
        ...
        <textN>
